title: Remove a Visible Gemini Watermark from an Image
description: Clean up visible Gemini labels or marks from images you are authorized to edit. Does not remove invisible SynthID signals.
heading: Remove visible Gemini marks from your images
intro: Use a focused image cleanup workflow for visible labels and overlays. Invisible provenance signals such as SynthID are outside this tool’s scope.

process.heading: How to Remove a Visible Gemini Watermark
process.intro: Clean a visible Gemini label or overlay in three simple steps while keeping invisible provenance signals outside the tool’s scope.

steps.title: Upload Your Image
steps.description: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB that you own or have permission to edit.

steps.title: Remove the Visible Mark
steps.description: The tool processes the visible Gemini label or overlay while preserving the surrounding image details.

steps.title: Review and Download
steps.description: Compare the result, then download the cleaned image through a temporary link.

faq.heading: Questions About Removing Visible Gemini Watermarks
faq.intro: Learn what the tool can remove, which files it supports, and how your images are handled.

items.question: Does this remove Google SynthID?
items.answer: No. This page concerns visible marks only and does not detect or remove invisible SynthID signals.

items.question: What image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB.

items.question: Are my images kept private?
items.answer: Files are stored in private object storage and scheduled for automatic deletion after 24 hours.

items.question: Can I remove any watermark?
items.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Some protected or complex marks may require manual editing.
